feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 1012 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 20 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: 401(k) Plan Fee Calculator — All-In Cost vs Benchmark
entry.summary: Free 401(k) plan fee calculator for small-business owners and plan committees: all-in cost as a percent of assets and per participant, recordkeeper, advisor and fund fees, an editable size benchmark, and what the excess costs a participant over 20 years. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: App Review Insights — Free App Store and Google Play Review Analyzer
entry.summary: Free app review analyzer: drop in your Google Play or App Store review CSV and see which release dropped your rating, which complaints cost the most stars, and which unhappy reviews you have not answered. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: AWS IAM Policy Risk Check — Find Over-Broad Permissions in Your Policy
entry.summary: Free AWS IAM policy checker: paste a policy, trust policy or bucket policy and see admin wildcards, privilege-escalation actions, NotAction grants and public principals with fixes to review. Runs in your browser, no AWS access needed.

entry.title: Bid Leveling Worksheet — Compare Subcontractor Bids on the Same Scope
entry.summary: Free bid leveling worksheet: paste subcontractor bids, price the excluded and unaddressed scope at your estimate, and see whether the low bid is still lowest. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Brewery Excise Tax Calculator — Federal Beer Tax per Keg and Case
entry.summary: Free federal beer excise tax calculator for craft brewers: enter kegs, cases and barrels and see the CBMA $3.50 and $16 per barrel tax, the cost per keg and case, and what growing past 60,000 barrels does. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Coast FIRE Calculator — Do You Already Have Enough to Coast?
entry.summary: Free Coast FIRE and Barista FIRE calculator: see the savings you need today to coast to retirement, the age you cross that line, and the part-time income you need while coasting. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Coffee Cart Event Quote Calculator — Flat Fee vs Percentage
entry.summary: Free calculator for mobile coffee cart owners: compare a booking fee, a percentage of sales and a prepaid drink guarantee for an event, with break-even drinks and net per hour. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Distillery Excise Tax Calculator — Federal Spirits Tax per Bottle
entry.summary: Free federal spirits excise tax calculator for craft distillers: enter bottles and their proof, see proof gallons, the CBMA $2.70 and $13.34 tax, the cost per bottle and pour, and what growing past 100,000 proof gallons does. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: EU Pay Gap Report Calculator — Pay Transparency Directive Indicators
entry.summary: Free calculator for the EU Pay Transparency Directive: paste your payroll table and get the mean and median gender pay gap, variable pay gap, pay quartiles and the gap by job category with the 5% joint assessment flag. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Fixed-Bid Overrun Forecaster — Will This Job Finish Inside the Price?
entry.summary: Free fixed-price project forecaster: enter price, cost budget, percent complete and cost to date to see projected final cost, margin, CPI and SPI, and when the job stops paying. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Form 2290 HVUT Calculator — Heavy Vehicle Use Tax by Weight and Month
entry.summary: Free Form 2290 heavy highway vehicle use tax calculator for owner-operators and small fleets: tax by weight category, partial-year proration by first-use month, logging and 5,000-mile suspended trucks, due dates and cost per mile. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Grazing Lease Rate Calculator — AUMs, Head and Fair Rent
entry.summary: Free grazing lease calculator for ranchers and landowners: AUMs and head your pasture carries, rent per AUM, per head and per acre, the hay-feeding break-even, and the rent range where both sides win. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Hay Sale Price Calculator — Break-Even and Best Bale Type
entry.summary: Free hay pricing calculator for hay producers: compare small squares, large squares and round bales on net profit per ton and per acre, with break-even price per bale. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: HOS Trip Planner — Will Your Load Make the Appointment?
entry.summary: Free hours-of-service trip planner for owner-operators and dispatchers: enter your remaining drive, window and cycle clocks and your stops, and see the schedule with required breaks, 10-hour resets and the real arrival time. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: House Hack Calculator — Can the Rent Pay Your Mortgage?
entry.summary: Free house hacking calculator for a duplex, triplex or fourplex: FHA or conventional payment with mortgage insurance, the rent you need to live free, the FHA self-sufficiency test, and the 10-year return versus renting. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Hunting Lease Income Calculator — What Will My Land Net?
entry.summary: Free hunting lease income calculator for landowners: compare a flat club lease, per-hunter seasonal leases and paid day hunts after insurance, upkeep and lost use, and see the break-even rate per acre. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Invoice Factoring Cost Calculator — True Cost and APR of a Factoring Offer
entry.summary: Free invoice factoring calculator: enter advance rate, fee per period and days to pay, and see the true cost, percent of invoice, annualised rate and rebate. Compare several factors side by side. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Mobile Vet House-Call Fee Calculator — Cost, Zone Surcharge and Daily Profit
entry.summary: Free calculator for mobile veterinarians: what a house call really costs after drive time, mileage, supplies, assistant time and no-shows, the visit fee and travel-zone surcharge that reach your margin, and profit per day. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: On-Call Load Analyzer — Is Your Pager Rotation Fair and Quiet?
entry.summary: Free on-call load analyzer: paste a PagerDuty, Opsgenie or Grafana OnCall incident CSV and see who carries the pager, night and weekend pages, noisy and self-resolving alerts, and the hours a cleanup would give back. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Oyster Farm Growout Planner — Net Per Crop and Break-Even Price
entry.summary: Free oyster farm planner: enter seed, survival, growout months, gear, lease and prices by grade, and see net per crop, break-even price and survival, and the cash needed before the first sale. Runs in your browser.
